app_summary.text: Music library, player and LAN sync
app_summary.note: The app's one-line description in the applications menu and software centres.

app_description.text: A music library manager and player. It autotags your collection against MusicBrainz and keeps every device in sync over the local network, with no server and no cloud.
app_description.note: The app's description in software centres.

app_keywords.note: Search terms for the applications menu, not shown. Each ends with a semicolon; translations may add the English ones.

field_label.note: A label in front of a text box, e.g. "Port:".

welcome_text.text:
musicapp keeps your music in one library folder. Imported music is copied there, organised by artist and album, along with the library database.

Use {0}?

Choose No to pick a different folder.
welcome_text.note: {0} is a folder. Yes, No and Cancel are the system's buttons.

windows.onedrive_warning:
This folder is synced by OneDrive. Sync can damage the library database while musicapp is writing to it.

Use it anyway?

usage.text:
musicapp.exe [--config-dir <folder>] [--] [folders or files to import...]

--config-dir <folder>
    Keeps settings.json and sync.db in <folder> instead of %LOCALAPPDATA%\musicapp, so two copies of musicapp can run, and sync, on one PC.

Folders and files given are imported.
usage.note: Command-line help. Leave musicapp.exe, the options, settings.json, sync.db and %LOCALAPPDATA%\musicapp as they are.

title_config_dir.note: The window title when started with a settings folder of its own, {0}, to tell copies apart.
